title: Quality heatmap + minimal repro generator for incident-driven regressions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: After the Feb 10 production spike in hallucination rate on multi-turn long-prefix prompts, the on-call postmortem identified a correlated rollout: a combined config change (kv_cache_ttl reduction + quantization-profile v2) that increased tokenization boundary shifts and degraded reranker scores for certain prompt families. This ticket creates a repeatable minimal-repro harness, a dashboard-style "quality heatmap" to show per-config per-prompt-family deltas, and automated synthetic tests that gate config rollouts. Goal: reduce MTTI (time-to-investigate) for future incidents and prevent regressions by blocking unsafe config changes during canary windows.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible minimal harness (CLI + Docker) that can replay a failing prompt bundle and capture model outputs and token-level diffs
A quality heatmap dashboard that shows delta in precision/recall/reranker score and hallucination-rate per prompt-family between current and candidate config across 3 load samples
Synthetic tests integrated into rollout pipeline that fail a canary if hallucination-rate increases by >2% on a targeted prompt set
Runbook section added: how to generate minimal repro, open a tracing link, and create a hotfix patch with rollback instructions
Cross-team demo and sign-off from PM (Lina Park) and Design (Nina Rao)
steps_taken: Collected 48h of incident traces and sampled 12 prompt families that showed statistically significant deltas
Built a first-pass tokenizer-boundary diff script to align outputs across quantization profiles
Prototyped a small harness that loads a snapshot of model weights + config and replays recorded requests in deterministic order
Spun up a light Grafana panel to visualise per-family hallucination-rate delta against baseline
decision_log: 2025-02-19: Decided to focus on 'prompt-family' bucketing (semantic + length) rather than per-customer buckets to avoid PII handling in test sets
2025-02-20: Chose to gate on hallucination-rate delta (2% threshold) and reranker-score delta (0.03 absolute) during canary windows
2025-02-21: Agreed to use synthetic prompt augmentation (paraphrases + prefix extension) to amplify brittle cases for faster detection
